title: duscope_explain
description: The arguments of duscope_explain, which runs `duscope explain`.

path.description: The file or directory to explain, under one of the server's roots: absolute, or relative to the scan's root. Default: the scan's root, or the server's root when it has one

scan_id.description: The saved scan to read the path's totals from: an id duscope_scan or duscope_scans gave (its first 4 or more characters will do), or latest. Default: the newest saved scan that holds the path, else the path as it is now
